breakdown.description: The load is extended from the intended partial top segment to the whole top boundary
breakdown.reason: The generated specification failed to fix the inconsistency. It instructs to 'Apply a vertical downward traction of -10 kPa on the entire top boundary of the domain', which directly repeats the user's incorrect instruction from the end of the prompt. The ground truth correctly specifies that the traction should be applied only on the partial top segment where 0.3 <= x <= 0.5.
